answer: Make every agent answer to one verified human supervisor, not a relic of passwords. First, the supervisor passes a liveness check, locks 400 POA, and sponsors at most three agents. Second, each agent files a weekly work log the supervisor signs; a fake log slashes the bond and freezes all three slots for 180 days. Third, supervisors are re-checked quarterly, so an ember of old trust cannot smolder forever. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 3,334 supervisors at $150 each, $500,100, plus 3.3M POA in bonds. Like a nebula collapsing into stars, clones cannot hide once each must orbit a real sun.
